vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security updates get a shorter soak, not none. Waiting the full 3 days on a known CVE is its own risk, but merging a release published minutes ago — unattended, straight into the cluster — is exactly the case the age gate exists for: a poisoned release is least likely to have been noticed while it is brand new. Most advisory fix versions are already older than this by the time the advisory lands, so in practice this delays almost nothing.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Every open alert here is a transitive dependency in package-lock.json, which no direct-dependency bump reaches. The refresh is age-gated at resolution time by min-release-age in .npmrc, and the build job installs from the refreshed lock file and compiles against it.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as a workflow env var or action input. actionlint and zizmor install an exact version instead of the release page's `latest`, so the pin has to be something Renovate can see. extractVersionTemplate drops the tag's leading v to match how the version is written in the file.

packageRules.description: Automerge patch/minor and digests (gated by digest-cooldown for docker)
